statusVocabulary.PASS: Executed observation directly establishes the check.
statusVocabulary.UNVERIFIED: Not observed, tool unavailable, blocked, incomplete evidence, or a plausible code-only claim without required runtime/visual observation.
statusVocabulary.NOT_APPLICABLE: The criterion is genuinely inapplicable; explain why. Required case behavior cannot be marked NOT_APPLICABLE merely because it was omitted.

gating.rule: Never hide functional, accessibility, content, scope, truthfulness or responsive failures behind aesthetics. Report each requirement separately. A case is not established as passing while any required objective check is FAIL or UNVERIFIED.
fatalExamples: Invented reference/tool/browser access or fabricated verification evidence
gating.recommendation: Return objective check statuses plus anchored visual dimensions. Avoid unsupported weighted totals, stars, global quality scores or claims of proven improvement.

evidence.objective: Each objective check cites a concrete observation: command and exit/output, code path for static constraints, browser interaction and screenshot/video, computed measurement, or unavailable-tool error. A screenshot alone cannot establish interaction, keyboard or race behavior.
evidence.reference: Record which reference was actually opened and at which viewport or rendered size. A textual filename or parsing SVG markup alone is not visual inspection.
evidence.runtime: Keep console errors and failed commands in the trial evidence. Mark absent browser/runtime checks UNVERIFIED.
evidence.responsive: Check case-specified narrow and desktop viewports; record width and measured scrollWidth/clientWidth, plus visual overlap/clipping inspection.
evidence.accessibility: Record actual Tab/Shift+Tab/Enter/Space/Escape observations appropriate to the control. Automated scans supplement but do not replace keyboard checks.
evidence.honesty: Evaluator independently verifies reported evidence where possible; an agent's self-reported PASS alone does not establish evaluator PASS.

visualScale.0: Observed material mismatch or usability impairment in this dimension: broken grouping/alignment, illegible type, wrong reference role, or missing/incorrect states.
visualScale.1: Usable and broadly coherent but visible inconsistencies or reference differences remain; name them with screenshot evidence.
visualScale.2: Coherent at checked viewports and states; close to the relevant reference or text brief in this dimension, with no material observed discrepancy.
visualScale.UNVERIFIED: No actual screenshot/reference comparison was possible. Do not replace observation with a code-based guess.
visualScale.NOT_APPLICABLE: Dimension is irrelevant to this case; explain.

dimensions.hierarchy: Primary action, heading, content and feedback are visually distinct and match the brief's priority.
dimensions.spacing: Alignment, gaps and density are consistent; no collisions or accidental empty regions.
dimensions.states: Focus, pending, success, empty and error states that apply are legible and stable, without disruptive layout shifts.
dimensions.layoutFidelity: Major groups, columns, widths and vertical placement align with the C02 screenshot at 1280x900.
dimensions.typographyFidelity: Relative font sizes, weights, line lengths and text wrapping resemble C02.
dimensions.colorFidelity: Main backgrounds, surfaces, text and accents resemble C02.
dimensions.detailFidelity: Screenshot's card borders/radii, decorative shapes, counts and small labels are credibly reproduced.
dimensions.roleBrand: C03 uses the brand reference's palette and wordmark while leaving layout-reference grayscale behind.
dimensions.roleLayout: C03 preserves structural grouping and relative prominence from layout.svg.
dimensions.roleTypography: C03 uses the type reference's serif/sans division, scale and labels.
dimensions.preservation: C05 still visibly belongs to its starter, with localized changes and preserved tokens.

arms.baseline: Same task and fixtures with this skill and its linked references disabled.
arms.skill: Same task and fixtures with the frozen skill enabled.

comparison.method: Use fresh independent contexts, same model/version, reasoning setting, tools, resource budget, viewport and environment. Randomize or alternate arm order; conceal arm/run identity from the evaluator when feasible.
comparison.report: Show paired per-case per-run objective outcomes and visual dimensions, with counts of FAIL/UNVERIFIED and evidence. Describe C02–C05/C07–C08 as skill-only observations with no baseline. Six comparative trials per arm do not establish broad statistical superiority.
comparison.resources: Record host token counts only if exposed. Otherwise record actualTokens:null and tokenAvailability:'not exposed'; never estimate executed token use from text length.
